title: An amount may now be at most 500,000 cents, the most the venue's payment provider takes in one payment; limits.json changed, the bound line forgotten

the bound test's fingerprint does not follow values read from JSON
note: money's tests pass (they read the limit). bookings' bound party test opens a booking of 200 people for 2 nights (600,000 cents), which amount now refuses: bookings' test fails. Amount's bound line still says 10,000,000.
